description: This is a PHP source file that defines the configuration class for the Recruitment plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements the PluginConfigurationInterface and registers several recruitment-related services (VacancyService, RecruitmentAttachmentService, CandidateService) into a dependency injection container during initialization.

classes.name: RecruitmentPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up recruitment services within the plugin, implementing plugin interface and registering services into the container.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin configuration by registering recruitment services into the dependency injection container.
